# `ext::http2` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../extended/ext/http2.lani#L10)

Layer: `ext`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

I/O-free HTTP/2 client connection engine: the caller sends output() and feeds received bytes. Multiplexes request streams under the smaller of the peer's MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS and a local cap, runs flow control both ways (round-robin DATA within windows and frame size, WINDOW_UPDATE at half a window, overflow and violation errors, INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE deltas), applies and acknowledges SETTINGS (push disabled), answers PING, honours GOAWAY and RST_STREAM (refused streams marked retryable), assembles CONTINUATION and validates responses (one :status, 1xx skipped, 101 rejected, field syntax, connection-specific fields, content-length, trailers). Connection errors send GOAWAY and fail every stream; stream errors send RST_STREAM. Passes 17 cases against libnghttp2's server session and 46 hand-built raw-frame cases.
